train_dynamics_model: train a dynamics model using ModelTrainer with a TransitionIterator dataset and Adam optimizer
evaluate_model_on_dataset: evaluate a trained model on a validation dataset using ModelTrainer evaluate method
create_model_trainer: create a ModelTrainer instance with a model, learning rate, weight decay, and optional logger
check_model_improvement: check if model validation score improved using maybe_get_best_weights with a threshold
restore_best_model_weights: restore the best model weights and set elite models using _maybe_set_best_weights_and_elite
